title: Umphefumulo Obekezelayo
intro: Ezincwadini zomlando zobuprofethi, kwakukhona umphefumulo onesineke esaqoshwa emzimbeni wawo. Ngokukhala nangesikhathi, babambelela ethembeni, baba yisibonelo esingapheli sokuthembela ekuhlakanipheni kwaphezulu. Ungakwazi yini ukuxazulula imfihlakalo yalesi sibalo esingaguquki?
clues: Ngazalelwa emndenini wabaprofethi, kodwa uvivinyo lwami olukhulu lwafika ngengane engangiyithanda kakhulu.
Ngithole isixwayiso somhawu ephusheni indodana yami eyalisho, futhi ngangesaba ukuphepha kwayo.
Amehlo ami aphenduka aba mhlophe ngenxa yosizi, kodwa angikaze ngilahlekelwe ukholo esiheni sika-Allah.
Iphunga lomntwana wami olahlekile langifinyelela kude, futhi ngangazi ngaleso sikhathi ukuthi ukuhlangana kabusha kwakuseduze.
Umndeni wami wakhothama ngokubonga lapho umbono wakudala ugcwaliseka, futhi amehlo ami abuyiselwa.
Nginguyena owanikezwa ihembe eligcwele igazi, kodwa kamuva ngathola ihembe elangiphulukisa.

arabic: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَشْكُوا۟ بَثِّى وَحُزْنِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verse: He said, "I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allāh, and I know from Allāh that which you do not know. (12:86)
